records.status: NOT COMMITTED. Held locally by the authorized analyst (Ra's machine) per the disclosure; deletable on request. The first rev-10 pass (d9f6ffc, 2026-09-11 ~18:30–20:00Z) published pseudonymized event-level rows on the unmerged PR branch of the fork; the branch history was rewritten to remove them the same day after review (Mica, blocker 1). Clones or caches taken in that window may still hold that commit; nothing can be done about copies already taken except to say so here.
records.why: event-level rows with exact timestamps are re-identifiable even under keyed pseudonyms (a public message's timestamp names its author's pseudonym), and the disclosure promised aggregates only.
records.digestPurpose: the analyst's audit trail: a re-run over the same local records reproduces report.json byte-for-byte (its digest below); the digests themselves reveal nothing.

rawHarvest.note: The raw harvest (timestamp, author id, message id, bytes, thread flag; NO text field) is NOT committed: author and message ids are stable, rehydratable references. It stays local to the analyst's machine per the disclosure. The committed records are derived from it by pseudonymize.py with an HMAC key held outside the repository.

The one-off extraction script was not retained; the raw files above are its complete output and are digested here.

participantKind.rule: raw author id prefix: user:* = human; webhook:* and persona:* = agent (residents post through the relay's webhook/persona identities)

pooled.note: pooled pairs are formed within each room and then concatenated; distinct authors are counted across rooms (some agents post in both), which is why the pooled author count is less than the per-room sum — the RFC's earlier '26 speakers' was that sum

thresholdSweep.fragmentation: share of a kind's self-continuation gaps > T
thresholdSweep.holdTax: count of handoff gaps < T, and the median of (T - gap) over them
thresholdSweep.holdTaxAgentOrigin: the same over handoffs whose departing speaker is an agent — the only handoffs an agent-only burst hold can delay; the column §6 cites (all-handoff hold tax is descriptive only)
